title: Short title, e.g. 'Dramatic middle, resolved ending'
selected: What the tool picked and how it described the hook/cliffhanger (from promos.json).
why_wrong: Why a human reviewer judged it wrong or weak (from the blind review notes).
better_cut: The better cut (timestamps), or why the clip should simply be rejected.
fix: What you would change in the pipeline to prevent this class of failure.
